verified_findings: The repository provides a reusable AGENTS template, generic skills, selected-provider portrait skills and router, generic Codex subagents, Codex configuration, an MCP integration guide, an optional bounded 3D adapter package, and an offline wiki tree.
The portrait component graph separates the complete production contract and explicit router from Cloud, Local, and RunPod skills; disabled projects do not receive those components.
The selected portrait provider lock uses comfyui-hoi4-portraits b47222a and its current eight-file model manifest; non-sourced fictional or impossible portraits use native ImageGen.
The provider-neutral MCP component uses hoi4-agent-tools.cmd through a Windows-only verified bootstrap and app-owned health route; Codex adds structural TOML registration separately.
The published MCP capability list names the working hoi4.tech_inspect, hoi4.tech_render, and hoi4.tech_compare Technology Tree Viewer routes.
The current 3D bootstrap, production blender_hoi4 adapter, and wrappers use Windows paths, .cmd wrappers, PowerShell guidance, winget, and blender.exe discovery.
The published 3D component declares uv and binds the reviewed automatic bootstrap arguments, network access, expected writes, privilege, and rollback boundary.

The source-owned manifest workflow regenerates path, size, and SHA-256 evidence when declared component trees change, so newly published skills and subagents are dynamically consumable by compatible app versions.

The Meshy runtime uses an exact npm lock and complete 3,916-file runtime identity; the project config delegates credential-bearing execution to the external app-owned launcher, which privately copies and revalidates the runtime and exact publisher-checked Node bytes. Blender MCP is resolved to an exact commit at bootstrap and io_pdx_mesh is pinned to release 0.91 with exact size and SHA-256 evidence.
The wiki snapshot has a distribution marker but no formal source or license metadata was verified.
Exact-commit content must be authoritative because repository directory views and cached listings can lag or differ.
verification_limits: Every manifest-declared skill and subagent path was re-inventoried with immutable Git-blob evidence. Newly added and changed contract surfaces, including the portrait router, Debug and Playtest skill, AI probability and event UI subagents, MCP integration guide, and bounded 3D adapter, were inspected; unchanged workflow prose relies on the prior full-read audit plus current path, size, and SHA-256 verification.
The offline wiki distribution and required page coverage were inspected. The body of every wiki article and every binary media file was not fully read.
Binary reference assets under skill trees were not individually inspected because this task designs an installer rather than an asset workflow output.
No formal repository or wiki license file was found at the tested paths. This is not a legal conclusion.
